details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1494-1532 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: assemble_judge_static_context picks the agents file with `[ -f AGENTS.md ]` / `[ -f agents.md ]`, which follows symlinks. When the index helper refuses the symlink and assemble_agents.py render also refuses it, the inline fallback `cat "${judge_agents_file}"` reads through the symlink.
  WHY: A hostile branch can commit `AGENTS.md -> .git/config`. The poller clone's `.git/config` carries `x-access-token:<GH_PAT>`, so the credential lands in judge_static.txt and goes to the model. The orchestrate.yml and orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml sites already add `[ ! -L ]` guards, and the issue says "Keep the existing symlink and non-regular-file guards". Severity differs: gemini and minimax said BLOCKER, z-ai said MAJOR; the highest is used.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:4151-4197 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: VALIDATE_AGENTS_FILE is picked with the same symlink-following `-f` test, and the inline fallback `cat "${VALIDATE_AGENTS_FILE}"` at line 4196 reads through a symlinked AGENTS.md.
  WHY: A hostile PR head with AGENTS.md pointing at .git/config gets the `.git/config` content pasted into the validation prompt, and that model runs with secrets in scope (validate.yml forwards OPENROUTER_API_KEY). Severity differs: gemini and minimax said BLOCKER, z-ai said MAJOR; the highest is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8365-8428 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The security-pass exhaustion judge now follows index mode. Its static prefix is built in the poller working directory, or reused from judge_static.txt, but the model runs inside SECURITY_PASS_AUDIT_WORKTREE, which is the branch under audit (prepared at lines 8760-8800). The model is told to read agents.md from that tree.
  WHY: With STATIC_CONTEXT_AGENTS_MODE unset, the audited branch's own agents.md shapes the rules applied to it. This is the same trust-boundary change the PR avoided for the review-blocked judge, and the index line numbers come from another tree. Suggested fix: give this judge its own judge_static_sec.txt assembled with the inline override, and update the count assertion in test_review_blocked_and_integration_judges_stay_inline plus the fragment and changelog wording.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1430-1560 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The cached judge_static.txt is keyed only by RUNTIME_DIR and the `[ ! -s ]` existence check, not by checkout ref or project. Minimax cites the cache check at line 28912.
  WHY: When the poller switches projects or integration branches (checkout selection at lines 6250-6277), a later judge can reuse an index built from another project's agents.md, so its line numbers point at the wrong sections in the sandbox's agents.md. No test covers this per-project cache behaviour.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8370-8375 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `if [ ! -s "${static_file}" ]` reuse at 8370-8375 and 19700-19705 lets the stall and security-pass judges inherit a judge_static.txt index built from a different project's checkout (compare 30910 wave judge re-assembly and 6250-6283 per-project checkout switching).
  WHY: The line pointers in the prompt can land on unrelated content. agents.d/8269-unattended-prompt-diet.md documents this as an accepted residual with STATIC_CONTEXT_AGENTS_MODE=inline as the rollback, and it is flagged so the editor re-confirms that tradeoff. The root cause matches the 1430-1560 cache finding but the cited lines differ, so it is not merged.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1494-1509 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The judge and validate pickers (orchestrate_poll_process.sh lines 1494-1498 and 1509; validate_process.sh lines 4151-4155 and 4173) select a symlinked AGENTS.md with `-f`, but the new named-file emitter (build_static_context.sh lines 528-533) returns empty output for a symlink. Each site then falls back to inline with reason=index_unavailable, even when a regular agents.md exists.
  WHY: In a repo whose AGENTS.md is a symlink, index mode never takes effect for validate or for the wave, stall and security judges. Every run emits a misleading warning pair and fallback=inline telemetry, which hides real index-builder failures. This is degraded behaviour, not a crash.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "If that plan file is on your checkout, its Phase 4 section and Decisions D1-D3 are authoritative; where they differ from this body, follow the plan and say so in the PR description."
  expected_change_site: PR description
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR description carries only the pre-push gate summary and the issue references ("Automated implementation. Closes .../issues/8269. Refs #8253"). It does not state that the issue body's "Phase 4" (the four-site cutover) is the plan's Phase 2 step 6 (lines 242-265). It does not state that the plan's actual Phase 4 / D5 (lines 288-301 and 75-86, Claude launch-path stripping) was not delivered. It does not state that step 6's heal-intake, mount and staged-support items (workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh, workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml env pass-through, sandbox mounts) were left out because of files_touched.
- requirement: Plan Phase 4 / D5: strip the system-instruction block from a temporary prompt copy on every Claude `--system-prompt-file` launch path when STATIC_CONTEXT_AGENTS_MODE=index, keep the original prompt for the exit-75 codex fallback, reword run_plan_codex.sh, and test the fallback.
  expected_change_site: scripts/ai_engine.sh (claude_run / claude_run_selected), scripts/clarify_isolated_run.sh, scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh, scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:15-17, and a Phase 4 fallback test
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR changes only the two mode-validate-generate.txt prompt copies and the four self-assembled sites. No hunk touches ai_engine.sh, clarify_isolated_run.sh, review_untrusted_sandbox.sh or run_plan_codex.sh, and there is no launch-path stripping or exit-75 fallback test. Sonnet explicitly excluded this gap as belonging to other sub-issues outside files_touched.
- requirement: Plan Decision D3 (unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:44-52): "all ## / ### headings, plus bullet-level entries for the 6 sections over 30 KB, with line ranges. Target index size is 15 KB or less."
  expected_change_site: scripts/build_static_context.sh (emit_agents_index; lines 506-580), with a regression test in tests/test_static_context_agents_index.py
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The emitter still matches only `## ` headings, emits single line numbers, has no bullet entries for the sections over 30 KB, and is still capped at 32 KiB rather than 15 KiB. The PR only adds the optional named-file argument (scripts/build_static_context.sh:528-534), and neither the agents.d fragment nor the changelog mentions D3. Sonnet and z-ai considered this out of scope or pre-existing (the emitter shipped in #8254).
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8365-8375, 8417-8428 (worktree prepared at 8764-8800) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The security-pass exhaustion judge follows index mode, but its static prefix comes from the poller working directory or a cached judge_static.txt, while the model runs inside SECURITY_PASS_AUDIT_WORKTREE, the audited integration head.
  WHY: The audited branch's own agents.md shapes the rules applied to it (a trust-boundary change), the index line numbers come from another tree, and the fragment's claim that the snapshots "hold the agents file" is false for this judge. Fix: a separate judge_static_sec.txt assembled with the inline override, then update the test count assertion and the fragment and changelog wording.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1494-1498, 1509; scripts/validate_process.sh:4151-4155, 4173; build_static_context.sh:528-533 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A symlinked AGENTS.md picked with `-f` makes the named-file emitter return empty output, so the site falls back to inline with reason=index_unavailable even when a regular agents.md exists.
  WHY: Index mode never takes effect for validate or the wave, stall and security judges in such repos, and the misleading warnings and telemetry hide real index-builder failures. This is degraded behaviour, not a crash.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "If that plan file is on your checkout, its Phase 4 section and Decisions D1-D3 are authoritative; where they differ from this body, follow the plan and say so in the PR description."
  Expected change site: PR description
  Evidence of absence: The PR description has only the pre-push gate summary. It does not mention the numbering mismatch: the plan's Phase 4 (lines 213-214 and 288-301, D5) differs from this issue's work, which is Phase 2 step 6 (lines 242-265). It also does not mention that the heal-intake and mount items were left out. The plan's Phase 4 and D3 gaps from pass 1 are excluded as belonging to other sub-issues outside files_touched.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- Notes: The pass-1 "critical" symlink cat-fallback finding is treated as pre-existing hardening, not a defect. Cache staleness predates the PR and is documented in the fragment. The z-ai wc pipeline finding is not a defect.
- HARDENING (2 related items): scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh assemble_judge_static_context lines 1494-1498, and scripts/validate_process.sh VALIDATE_AGENTS_FILE picker lines 4151-4155. Add `&& [ ! -L AGENTS.md ]` / `&& [ ! -L agents.md ]` (about 2 lines each). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
